name: status-report
title: Project status report
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM projects ORDER BY name

sections.title: Work
sections.sql: SELECT task,owner,status,due_on,remaining_hours,blockers FROM v_task_board WHERE project_id=$1 ORDER BY due_on NULLS LAST,task

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: SELECT name,status,due_on,outcome FROM decisions WHERE project_id=$1 ORDER BY due_on

name: handover
title: Project handover record
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM projects ORDER BY name

sections.title: Notes
sections.sql: SELECT t.name,n.actor,n.body,n.created_at FROM notes n JOIN tasks t ON t.id=n.task_id WHERE t.project_id=$1 ORDER BY n.created_at
